name: refund-triage
description: Triage a refund request: a calibrated judge reads the message; a clear, fraud-free request is refunded, anything uncertain goes to a person, and nothing is refunded without one or the other.

assess.why: read the request with a calibrated judge

review.why: a person decides what the judge could not

unstoppable.refunding: the refund is in flight: stopping would not unsend it; the run ends when the payment provider answers
